headline: Nvidia ~+4% pre-market on beat, VIX 25.46 Tue, gold below $3,800, Fed minutes today
stance: US futures rose overnight on the chip results after a lower close Tuesday. Fed minutes today, with the 10y at 5.10%.

news.head: Nvidia ~+4% pre-market after beat-and-raise
news.body: Guides ~$130bn next quarter and ~75% growth next year. Board rules out Huang's return. No 10-Q filed yet (~5am ET).

news.head: Tencent Q3 non-GAAP EPS RMB 7.227
news.body: Revenue RMB 207.34bn. Online advertising up ~19% y/y (~4:55am ET).

news.head: Pony AI Q3 beats
news.body: Non-GAAP loss $0.11 per ADS, $0.07 better than estimates. Revenue $44.57m, $5.45m above (~4:19am ET).

implications: Gold fell through $3,800 as Gulf attacks spread. A 10y above 5% is weighing on it more than the conflict.
Only 47.5% of Nasdaq 100 stocks sat above their 200-day line Tuesday. One beat does not fix that breadth.

watch.head: Target reports before the open
watch.body: Turnaround progress and holiday outlook in focus.

watch.head: Housing starts, Nov 18, 8:30
watch.body: Permits also at 8:30. Foreign Treasury flows (TIC) at 4:00pm.

watch.head: FOMC minutes, today
watch.body: Treasury yields flat into the release (~4:32am ET).

watch.head: Trump meets Xi and Putin in Shenzhen
watch.body: Trump landed for trilateral talks (~4:11am ET). New US rules curb AI-chip sales to Southeast Asian data centers.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Gold traded below $3,800 overnight (~11:35pm ET). Treasuries flat ahead of Fed minutes (~4:32am ET).
Brent $92.49 (~12:55am ET) after a private survey showed a crude build. A tanker was attacked in Hormuz Tuesday evening.
UK CPI 3.6%, as expected; services 3.7% vs 3.8%. Ueda kept a December BOJ hike open (~8:23pm ET).
sections.positioning: Spec 5y Treasury longs 94th %ile, down 5 points on the week. Spec sterling at the 12th %ile, extended short, up 6 points.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Nasdaq 100 futures +1.3% after Tuesday's close (~6:46pm ET). Dow and S&P 500 futures higher (~4:51am ET).
Japan October exports +20.5%; semiconductor shipments up almost 50% y/y (~7:35pm ET).
S&P 500 sits below its 200-day average after Tuesday's drop.
sections.positioning: Spec Russell 2000 longs 99th %ile, 6 weeks at the extreme. VIX specs extended short at the 10th %ile, standing.

single_name.note: Score 5, new to the screen. Insider buy filed Nov 16. Trades above its 200-day line, 14.2 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Latest IG and HY spreads are Monday's. Tuesday's VIX rise to 25.46 is not in them yet.
Listed BDCs trade at 0.92x NAV, median, at Tuesday's close.
ECB stability review flags AI valuations and fiscal gaps as financial risks (~4:00am ET).
sections.positioning: No credit COT extreme. Dealer IG inventory mid-range, 73rd %ile of 3 years.
